redirect.message: Choosing the best language for you…

diagram.caption: DokoSoko turns everything a developer needs to integrate your product into one secure path for the coding agent they already use.

hero.description: Help developers reach a working integration faster. DokoSoko gives coding agents one exact, authorized path through your product—so integrating takes less searching, less guessing, and fewer retries.

outcomes.label: Why DokoSoko
outcomes.title: Faster adoption. Less friction. More customers getting value.
outcomes.description: DokoSoko removes the integration friction between choosing your product and getting value from it.

speed.label: Speed
speed.title: Get customers to value faster.
speed.copy: Shorten the time between choosing your product and seeing it deliver value inside the customer’s business.

simplicity.label: Simplicity
simplicity.title: Make adoption feel effortless.
simplicity.copy: Remove the integration friction that slows evaluations, delays launches, and creates avoidable support work.

success.label: Success
success.title: Turn more interest into usage.
success.copy: Help more developers finish the integration, so more prospects become active, successful customers.

runSection.label: The integration gap
runSection.title: From weeks of integration work to one prompt.

traditional.summary: Integration becomes a project of its own—before your customer reaches value.

dokosoko.title: One approved path the agent can execute.

connect.title: Add the DokoSoko MCP
connect.copy: Give your coding agent one trusted source for docs, tools, and setup.

prompt.title: Tell the agent what to build
prompt.copy: Describe the outcome—not how to navigate the integration.

implement.title: Let the agent implement and test
implement.copy: The coding agent writes the integration, uses permitted tools, and iterates.

review.title: Review and ship
review.copy: Validate the result and get back to your product.

result.label: Outcome
result.title: Working integration
result.copy: The agent handles the implementation loop. Your customer stays in control.

mcpButton.label: The customer-facing button
mcpButton.title: One button. Every supported coding agent.
mcpButton.description: Add it to your docs or product. Customers get the exact setup path for Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, or OpenCode—in their language.
mcpButton.previewNote: The label, destination, language, and supported agents come from your DokoSoko deployment.
mcpButton.caption: The embeddable MCP button generated by DokoSoko.

workflow.label: How it works
workflow.title: Make the easiest integration the one customers choose.
workflow.description: Give every developer a clear path from first interest to successful use—without adding more work for your team.

publish.title: Make your product easy to adopt.
publish.copy: Bring the guidance and setup customers need into one experience their coding agent can follow.

guide.title: Help customers get to value.
guide.copy: Their coding agent uses your approved path to write and test the integration without sending developers across documentation, dashboards, and support tickets.

learn.title: See where customers succeed.
learn.copy: See a clear result for every completed run, so product and customer teams can improve adoption and support.

trust.label: Built for trust
trust.title: Confidence without slowing customers down.
trust.description: Give developers a fast path while keeping your product experience, sensitive access, and customer outcomes under control.

reliable.label: Reliable
reliable.title: Protect the customer experience.
reliable.copy: Customers follow product guidance you control, reducing inconsistent implementations and avoidable breakage.

safe.label: Safe
safe.title: Move faster without losing control.
safe.copy: Sensitive access stays protected and only approved setup actions can run, so speed does not create unnecessary risk.

visible.label: Visible
visible.title: Know what is working.
visible.copy: See a clear result for every completed run, giving product and customer teams a clearer picture of adoption.

closing.label: Make integration a product advantage
closing.title: Turn developer interest into successful adoption.
closing.description: Give every customer a faster, simpler path from first prompt to first value.
